article.headline: Utah faces Miami, seeks to halt 8-game slide
article.description: Miami Heat (4-6, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Utah faces Miami, seeks to halt 8-game slide
article.linkText: Utah faces Miami, seeks to halt 8-game slide
article.story: Miami Heat (4-6, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Tuesday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Utah aims to end its eight-game skid when the Jazz play Miami. Utah went 22-60 overall a season ago while going 14-27 at home. The Jazz allowed opponents to score 126.0 points per game and shoot 49.4% from the field last season. Miami finished 43-39 overall with a 17-24 record on the road a season ago. The Heat shot 46.8% from the field and 36.1% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Keyonte George: day to day (ankle), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee). Heat: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
